name: agent-memory-runtime-m4a
title: Agent Memory Runtime M4A graph adoption decision
description: Evaluate one currently maintained local graph projection against the accepted G3R SQLite adjacency baseline and record a hash-bound G4A GO or NO-GO without changing SQLite authority.

notes: Run ce-brainstorm, research-to-article, ce-plan, and ce-work in order under Trellis. Commit every completed unit separately. GO and NO-GO are both complete G4A outcomes.
